{"id": "ee5f99f8-793e-4827-b261-8e9475eb7495", "role": "user", "content": [{"text": "We're about to merge PR #14 in acme/payments-infra. It's the first infrastructure PR in that repo, there's no pipeline review set up, and finance wants to know what this stack is going to add to the AWS bill every month before we approve it. Can you work that out from the PR?

The attached material is what the repository integration and the AWS tools returned for this change. It is a synthetic test fixture: resource names, account results, SKUs and rates are made up, and the rates intentionally differ from real AWS list prices, so treat the rows below as the live lookup results for this run.

--- PR #14 (feature/ledger -> main) ---
Base branch main: no cloudformation/ directory.
Files added: cloudformation/payments-ledger.yaml, .github/workflows/deploy.yml

--- .github/workflows/deploy.yml (excerpt) ---
env:
  AWS_REGION: eu-west-1
  STACK_NAME: payments-ledger
run: aws cloudformation deploy --stack-name payments-ledger --template-file cloudformation/payments-ledger.yaml --region eu-west-1

--- cloudformation/payments-ledger.yaml (Resources; Parameters hold only VPC and subnet IDs) ---
  LedgerDbSubnetGroup: {Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup, Properties: {SubnetIds: [!Ref PrivateSubnetA, !Ref PrivateSubnetB]}}
  LedgerDb:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties: {Engine: postgres, DBInstanceClass: db.r6g.large, MultiAZ: true, AllocatedStorage: "200", StorageType: gp3, DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref LedgerDbSubnetGroup}
  ReconcilerNatEip: {Type: AWS::EC2::EIP, Properties: {Domain: vpc}}
  ReconcilerNatGateway: {Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway, Properties: {AllocationId: !GetAtt ReconcilerNatEip.AllocationId, SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA}}
  AlbSecurityGroup: {Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup}
  ApiLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties: {Type: application, Scheme: internet-facing, Subnets: [!Ref PublicSubnetA, !Ref PublicSubnetB], SecurityGroups: [!Ref AlbSecurityGroup]}
  ArchiveBucket: {Type: AWS::S3::Bucket, Properties: {VersioningConfiguration: {Status: Enabled}}}
  ReconcilerRole: {Type: AWS::IAM::Role}
  ReconcilerFunction: {Type: AWS::Lambda::Function, Properties: {Runtime: python3.12, Architectures: [arm64], MemorySize: 512, Role: !GetAtt ReconcilerRole.Arn}}

--- AWS (read-only), eu-west-1 ---
cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name payments-ledger
  -> ValidationError: Stack with id payments-ledger does not exist

--- pricing get-products (endpoint us-east-1, filter regionCode=eu-west-1), OnDemand terms only ---
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-01  usagetype EU-Multi-AZUsage:db.r6g.large   databaseEngine=PostgreSQL deploymentOption=Multi-AZ   0.500 USD per Hrs
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-09  usagetype EU-UnusedBox:db.r6g.large       databaseEngine=PostgreSQL deploymentOption=Multi-AZ   0.000 USD per Hrs   "unused capacity reservation hour"
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-02  usagetype EU-RDS:Multi-AZ-GP3-Storage     volumeType=General Purpose-GP3 databaseEngine=PostgreSQL   0.250 USD per GB-Mo
AmazonEC2  SKU FX-NAT-01  usagetype EU-NatGateway-Hours             productFamily=NAT Gateway   0.050 USD per Hrs
AmazonEC2  SKU FX-NAT-02  usagetype EU-NatGateway-Bytes             productFamily=NAT Gateway   0.050 USD per GB
AmazonVPC  SKU FX-IP-01   usagetype EU-PublicIPv4:InUseAddress                                  0.005 USD per Hrs
AWSELB     SKU FX-ALB-01  usagetype EU-LoadBalancerUsage            productFamily=Load Balancer-Application   0.025 USD per Hrs
AWSELB     SKU FX-ALB-03  usagetype EU-TS-LoadBalancerUsage         productFamily=Load Balancer-Application   0.006 USD per Hrs   "trust store unit-hour"
AWSELB     SKU FX-ALB-02  usagetype EU-LCUUsage                     productFamily=Load Balancer-Application   0.008 USD per LCU-Hrs", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
{"id": "22a673ca-68f2-40af-9154-9833b5694482", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "chat_title", "title": "Estimate monthly AWS bill impact for PR #14"}]}

{"id": "da25b6d5-bf61-4d98-8509-9aaddf913948", "role": "assistant", "block_type": "thinking", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "This is a direct calculation task since all pricing data is already in the prompt, so I don't need to gather additional context. I'll use the standard 730 hours/month convention and work through each resource's cost starting with the RDS LedgerDb instance.

For the RDS instance, storage comes to $50/mo (200GB at $0.250/GB-Mo) and compute to $365/mo (730hrs at $0.500/hr), totaling $415/mo. For the NAT Gateway, hourly cost is $36.50/mo, but data processing charges depend on usage volume I can't know, so I'll flag that as variable. The Elastic IP adds $3.65/mo using the given rate literally, even though that's unusual since in-use addresses are typically free when attached to a NAT gateway.

For the ALB, base usage comes to $18.25/mo, and I should exclude the TrustStore charge since mTLS isn't configured here. LCU-hours depend heavily on traffic patterns (connections, bandwidth, rule evaluations), so I'll flag that cost as variable rather than guessing a number.

For ArchiveBucket, there's no S3 pricing data given, so storage costs are usage-dependent and can't be quantified - I'll note it starts near zero but scales with data volume. Similarly, ReconcilerFunction's Lambda cost has no pricing data provided and depends entirely on invocation volume, so I'll flag it as usage-dependent with no fixed baseline.

Now I'm adding up the fixed monthly costs that apply regardless of traffic - RDS compute and storage, NAT Gateway hourly charge, EIP hourly charge, and ALB hourly charge - which sum to $473.40. Beyond that, I still need to account for variable components like NAT Gateway data processing fees and ALB LCU-Hour charges that scale with actual usage.

S3 and Lambda costs can't be estimated since no pricing data was supplied for those. I want to present the final answer as a clear table with assumptions noted (730 hrs/month, Multi-AZ, eu-west-1 region), and flag that the unused capacity reservation line item is $0 and doesn't add to the cost.

Running through the arithmetic: 200*0.25=50, plus 0.5*730=365, plus 0.05*730=36.5, plus 0.005*730=3.65, plus 0.025*730=18.25, summing to $473.40/month fixed baseline. I'll present this total clearly, note the assumptions made, and mention the CloudFormation stack doesn't exist yet.

"}]}

{"id": "2c5142d7-6c6f-4fce-b517-8b6b75c02cef", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Based on the resources in PR #14's template and the pricing lookups, here's what I can pin down. The stack doesn't exist yet (confirmed — no `payments-ledger` stack in eu-west-1 currently), so this is a pre-merge estimate from the template alone, using eu-west-1 rates and a 730-hr month.

## Fixed monthly baseline (~$473.40/mo)

These run whether or not the service sees traffic:

| Resource | Rate | Monthly |
|---|---|---|
| `LedgerDb` — db.r6g.large, Multi-AZ compute | $0.500/hr | $365.00 |
| `LedgerDb` — 200 GB gp3 storage, Multi-AZ | $0.250/GB-mo | $50.00 |
| `ReconcilerNatGateway` — hourly charge | $0.050/hr | $36.50 |
| `ReconcilerNatEip` — in-use public IPv4 | $0.005/hr | $3.65 |
| `ApiLoadBalancer` — ALB hourly charge | $0.025/hr | $18.25 |
| **Total fixed** | | **$473.40** |

(There's also a `db.r6g.large` "unused capacity reservation" SKU in the pricing data at $0.000/hr — that's a $0 line, not relevant here since this isn't a reserved-capacity deployment.)

## Usage-driven costs — not fixable from the PR alone

These scale with actual traffic/data, so I can't give finance a flat number without usage assumptions:

- **NAT Gateway data processing** — $0.050/GB. Depends on how much egress the reconciler pushes through the NAT.
- **ALB LCU-hours** — $0.008/LCU-hr. Depends on new connections, active connections, bandwidth, and rule evaluations once the API is live.
- **ArchiveBucket (S3)** — no pricing data came back for S3 in this lookup, and cost depends on object volume/requests. Versioning is enabled, so old versions will accumulate storage too.
- **ReconcilerFunction (Lambda)** — no pricing data returned either; cost depends on invocation count and duration, not the 512MB/arm64 config alone.
- The ALB trust-store SKU (`FX-ALB-03`) doesn't apply — the template has no trust store/mTLS configuration on this load balancer.

## Bottom line for finance

**~$473/month guaranteed baseline**, before any traffic. The real total will land higher once NAT data transfer, ALB LCUs, S3, and Lambda usage are factored in — those four are usage-dependent and need either a traffic estimate or a few weeks of post-launch billing data to pin down.

Want me to put this into a report artifact so finance has something to reference, or help estimate the variable piece once you have a rough traffic/throughput number in mind?", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
